notes: Perigold (Wayfair-owned) has NO dedicated Pet Care department/category anywhere in its site taxonomy. Reached directly via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome desktop profile per prior pass notes (plain requests/Playwright default fingerprint get PerimeterX 429/press-and-hold captcha; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, generic User-agent:* allows /*/sb0/, /*/sb1/, /*/sb2/). Absence checks performed: (1) full seo-category-sitemap~0.xml, 84 department/cat URLs - no 'pet'/'dog'/'cat'/'animal' department exists (only baby-kids, bath, bedding, decor, dining-entertaining, furniture, holiday, kitchen, lighting, outdoor, rugs, sale). (2) full seo-sb0-sitemap~0.xml, 376 leaf-category URLs - zero pet/dog/cat/litter/collar/leash/kennel matches except 'Animal Wall Art' (themed decor, excluded per boundary rules). (3) Homepage RSC payload mega-nav - 274 unique displayName nav nodes covering the entire site taxonomy, zero occurrences of the substring 'pet' anywhere (case-insensitive). (4) Site search for 'dog bed', 'pet bed', 'cat tree', 'pet' via keyword.php returns non-discriminating results pulling from mixed unrelated classes (facet 'Category' list mixes real furniture 'Beds'/'End Tables'/'Decorative Objects' alongside internal search-relevance-only class IDs 'Dog Beds & Mats' (masterClID 915), 'Crates and Carriers' (1008), 'Cat Beds' (3414) - these IDs are search facets only, with no corresponding public PLP/category URL found anywhere on the site; all matching product links found were individual PDP pages (/home/pdp/...), never a listing page). Tried multiple URL param guesses (masterClID=, class_id=, classId=, filters= JSON) on keyword.php - none produced a genuine filtered category page, only altered/default result counts. Attempted to click the facet interactively via Playwright to find a real filtered URL, but PerimeterX served a press-and-hold bot-check to the non-impersonated browser fingerprint (consistent with prior-pass notes) - not pursued further via Claude-in-Chrome since the sitemap+nav absence evidence was already conclusive and no crawlable PLP exists to record regardless. (5) Checked all 5 seo-keyword-sitemap~N.xml files (182,806 URLs total, all keyword.php search-landing pages, i.e. marketing/SEO pages not real categories) and seo-sb1-sitemap~0.xml (36,780 attribute-refinement URLs) for pet/dog/cat/etc substrings - all matches were either false positives (petite, petal, petrified, carpet, 'Recycled PET' = polyethylene terephthalate rug material), pet-themed decor excluded by the boundary rules (Dog/Cat Wall Art, Dog Paintings, Cat Prints, Dog Photography, Dogs Garden Statues, Cats & Dogs Wallpaper, Pets Picture Frames, Christmas Tree Skirts & Collars), Pet-Friendly Live Plants (excluded per prior Home-Decor pass rules - live plants category), or pet-hair-oriented cleaning appliances (Pet Tool/Pet Hair Friendly Vacuums & Steamers - human cleaning equipment, not pet care). No genuine navigable Pet Care PLP/category exists on perigold.com. Conclusion: 0 Pet Care rows.
